fusions.name: Scald Shot
fusions.desc: Sacrifices 4% of your maximum health to spit boiling water at the first enemy in its path up to 6 tiles away, dealing 8 damage and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Steam Vent
fusions.desc: The water on your skin flashes to steam 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 10 damage to everything in the cone and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Blistering Skin
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Boil
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
